statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 4, low, because CME equity index futures have been halted since 21:00Z on Friday and no tradable Nasdaq-100 price path exists inside any hour of this 24-hour horizon, which ends about five hours before the scheduled Sunday reopen at 22:00Z. Stress is 41, moderate: a 50% US tariff on roughly $20bn of Canadian goods is in force with talks suspended and a dollar-for-dollar match dated to 8 September, the latest H.15 column stands at 4.19% on the 2-year, 4.69% on the 10-year and 5.23% on the 30-year with the long end at its highest since 2007, and next week carries PCE, the second GDP estimate, Nvidia's results and a first Jackson Hole keynote from the current Fed Chair. Confidence is 87, high, because the closed-venue fact and every supporting index, volatility, yield, energy and calendar input were re-verified against primary sources this hour.
recommendation: The last observed session remains consistent with functioning mean reversion rather than a one-way path: cash NDX opened at 29,359.60, traded down to 29,142.44, recovered the entire decline to 29,405.12 and closed at 29,308.86, below its own open and up 0.33% on the day, while QQQ closed 0.35% higher at 713.44 and VIX settled at 14.89 near the low of a 14.77-15.95 range. Both session extremes were retraced and neither produced repeated extension after a failed pullback, so no Tail amplifier from observed structure is present. Because the venue is shut, no hour in this horizon can generate the shallow-pullback or extreme-holding behaviour that would move Tail toward the block threshold, and Tail therefore stays at its closed-venue floor while Stress carries the unpriced policy and rates stack. The danger window is empty by construction: there is no tradable interval inside the published horizon.
headline: Closed-venue assessment: CME equity index futures stay halted across all twenty-four published hours while a 50% US tariff on Canadian goods sits unpriced against a 30-year yield at its highest since 2007, and Tail holds the closed-venue floor of 4.
body: CME equity index futures stopped trading for the week at 21:00Z on Friday and reopen on Sunday at 22:00Z, so the venue is confirmed shut across all twenty-four slots published here, which run from 2026-08-22T18:00:00Z to 2026-08-23T17:00:00Z and end roughly five hours before that reopen. Cash NDX settled at 29,308.86 on Friday, up 95.69 points or 0.33% from a 29,213.17 previous close, after opening at 29,359.60 and printing a 29,142.44 low and a 29,405.12 high; both extremes were retraced inside the session and the close finished below the open, which is the shape of a market that still mean-reverts. QQQ closed the same session 0.35% higher at 713.44 within a 709.21-715.67 range, and VIX closed at 14.89, down 6.00%, near the bottom of a 14.77-15.95 range rather than at a stressed extreme. The dominant unpriced item is trade policy: talks between Washington and Ottawa collapsed shortly before the Friday midnight deadline, a 50% US tariff on roughly $20bn of Canadian goods took effect, and Prime Minister Carney suspended negotiations while dating a dollar-for-dollar response to 8 September, outside this horizon. The rates backdrop is the second unpriced item: the latest H.15 column shows 4.19% on the 2-year, 4.39% on the 5-year, 4.69% on the 10-year and 5.23% on the 30-year, with the long end at its highest since 2007, partly offset by the Treasury's 19 August decision to at least double its 10-to-30-year buyback operations from $2bn to $4bn per operation starting 9 September, a move that knocked 9 basis points off the 30-year on the day and lifted gold about 2.7%. Energy is elevated but stable, with WTI near $87.06 and Brent near $94.39 after a little-changed Friday, while Strait of Hormuz transits remain far below pre-conflict levels; that is a chronic constraint rather than a new discontinuity this weekend. Latest-session cross-asset context is mixed rather than aligned: five of eight megacaps closed higher with Nvidia 0.98% lower, semiconductors averaged -0.70% with the Philadelphia chips index roughly 5% lower on the week, gold rose sharply and Treasury futures fell. Mixed alignment supports Stress and reduces directional conviction; it does not mechanically raise Tail. The week ahead is dense, with PCE and the second GDP estimate on Wednesday, Nvidia's results the same evening and the Fed Chair's first Jackson Hole keynote on Friday, but every one of those is a scheduled checkpoint beyond this horizon rather than an observable condition inside it. Tail accordingly holds 4 in every published hour.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is close to complete: 22 hourly assessments are available, while the 05:00Z and 06:00Z clock-hours on 22 August have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across the available hours Tail held a narrow 4-16 band and the mapped policy state stayed EA_ON throughout, so no hour approached the block threshold. The path tracks the transition from the live Friday session, where Tail ran 10-16 and Stress 48-54 with a mixed dominant mode, into the futures halt at 21:00Z, after which Tail fell to the closed-venue floor of 4 and the dominant mode settled to normal. Stress fell with the halt to 35-38 overnight and then rebuilt to 42 through Saturday as the tariff step took effect, easing to 41 in the three most recent hours once the Canadian response was dated to 8 September. Confidence stayed in an 84-88 band throughout.
outlookSummary: The current hour carries Tail at 4 because CME equity index futures are confirmed halted and no Nasdaq-100 price path can develop inside this slot. All twenty-three remaining slots describe the same closed market: the final slot begins at 2026-08-23T17:00:00Z and ends about five hours before the Sunday 22:00Z reopen, so no live evidence can arrive before this forecast expires. Tail therefore holds 4 in every hour and the mapped policy state stays EA_ON, with the danger window empty because no tradable interval exists inside the horizon. Stress eases from 41 to a trough of 38 through the quiet Saturday evening and overnight hours, then rebuilds to 44 by the final slot as the reopen approaches with the tariff step, a post-2007 long end, the unresolved Iran shipping constraint and next week's PCE, GDP, Nvidia and Jackson Hole checkpoints all still unpriced. Confidence decays from 87 to 81 across the horizon purely because the last live price observation ages, not because any source degraded.
